assets_to_copy.reason: Best reusable visual asset set from v1: 27 guide/monthly folders, 307 public content images, already organized by guide slug and referenced with web-safe paths.
Monthly guide image sets do not exist in v2 seed/import flow yet and would make public guide pages feel much richer after reviewed content import.
High-value visual guides that directly match current Facebook import candidates and can be used as covers or content block images after review.

style_files_to_reference.reason: Contains the strongest v1 visual language: fonts, palette tokens, soft card styles, hero background, article blocks, bottom nav, and tone classes.
style_files_to_reference.migration_note: Do not copy Tailwind classes into v2 directly. Translate values into MUI theme tokens and sx/shared components.

style_files_to_reference.reason: Home page has a more editorial Thai-first hero, search suggestions, stat chips, quick category cards, and note-style featured panel.
style_files_to_reference.migration_note: Recreate layout in v2 MUI using live backend data; do not reuse static data imports.

style_files_to_reference.reason: Post detail page has better cover image treatment, tag/header hierarchy, source excerpt panel, related guides, additional image gallery, and source link panel.
style_files_to_reference.migration_note: Adapt to v2 Post + ContentBlock APIs and preserve current public rendering behavior.

style_files_to_reference.reason: Guide cards and category cards feel more like a community guidebook than v2 generic MUI cards.
style_files_to_reference.migration_note: Rebuild as MUI components using v2 Post/Category types.

style_files_to_reference.reason: Sticky cream header with small island mark and compact nav is more cohesive than v2 route-level pages without shared public chrome.
style_files_to_reference.migration_note: Implement as a v2 PublicLayout using React Router links.

style_files_to_reference.reason: Mobile bottom navigation improves public page usability and gives the app a companion-like mobile feel.
style_files_to_reference.migration_note: Add only for public pages; keep admin navigation separate.

style_files_to_reference.reason: Readable article block styling for paragraph, gallery, note, checklist, and closing blocks maps well to v2 content blocks.
style_files_to_reference.migration_note: Use as visual reference only; v2 block types are TEXT_BLOCK, IMAGE_BLOCK, VIDEO_BLOCK, HIGHLIGHT_BLOCK.

components_to_recreate.name: PublicLayout
components_to_recreate.reason: Give all public pages consistent header, footer, and mobile navigation without touching admin flows.
components_to_recreate.implementation_note: Use MUI AppBar/Box or plain Box components with React Router NavLink; hide bottom nav on tablet/desktop.

components_to_recreate.name: CozyHero
components_to_recreate.reason: v1 hero is Thai-first, guidebook-like, and has a charming note card using real post imagery.
components_to_recreate.implementation_note: Use live categories/posts/health data from v2; keep API status less visually dominant than guide discovery.

components_to_recreate.name: SectionHeading
components_to_recreate.reason: Reusable eyebrow/title/description/action pattern improves public page rhythm.
components_to_recreate.implementation_note: Implement with MUI Typography/Stack and theme typography variants.

components_to_recreate.name: CozyCategoryCard
components_to_recreate.reason: v1 category cards use icons, count badges, tone colors, and softer density than current v2 category cards.
components_to_recreate.implementation_note: Map existing v2 category slugs to icons/tone colors locally; do not require DB schema changes.

components_to_recreate.name: GuideCardWithImage
components_to_recreate.reason: v1 guide cards include thumbnails and image count badges, making public browsing feel less abstract.
components_to_recreate.implementation_note: Use first IMAGE_BLOCK/media URL when available; fallback to current text-only card.

components_to_recreate.name: CozySearchBar
components_to_recreate.reason: v1 search is friendlier and more prominent, especially with Thai placeholder text and suggestion chips.
components_to_recreate.implementation_note: Rebuild with MUI TextField/InputAdornment and keep v2 search API.

components_to_recreate.name: ArticleDetailShell
components_to_recreate.reason: v1 post detail has better article paper, cover treatment, source excerpt, image gallery, notes, and related-link affordances.
components_to_recreate.implementation_note: Translate visual style only; preserve v2 content block rendering and API loading/error states.

components_to_recreate.name: EmptyStateVisualTone
components_to_recreate.reason: v1 empty states are softer and more local to the island notebook concept.
components_to_recreate.implementation_note: Keep current reusable EmptyState API but adjust typography, icon, dashed border, and background.

theme_values.border_radius: Prefer 16px for inputs/buttons, 24px for cards/article blocks, 28px for special note panels while preserving admin usability.
theme_values.shadow_style: Soft green/blue shadows such as 0 8px 20px rgba(83, 111, 87, 0.15) and 0 16px 34px rgba(127, 183, 126, 0.16).
theme_values.background_style: Cream base with pale leaf/sky/peach/butter bands and subtle radial accents; avoid strong full-page gradients as the main public identity.

recommended_steps: Add Google font imports for Mali and Noto Sans Thai to v2 index/global CSS or Vite HTML, then update MUI typography safely.
Translate v1 palette into frontend/src/theme/appTheme.ts and verify contrast on public and admin pages.
Create a PublicLayout for public pages only, inspired by v1 Header, footer, and BottomNav.
Rework Home page hero/search/category/latest post sections using v1 patterns but v2 live APIs.
Rework PostCard and Category cards to support tone colors, icons, thumbnails, and image count badges without DB changes.
Improve PostDetailPage and ContentBlockRenderer with v1 article paper, cover/media, notes, source panel, and gallery styling.
Copy only reviewed public content image folders into frontend/public/content-images or import selected images through v2 media upload flow.
Run frontend build and browser checks across home, category, search, post detail, login, and admin pages after each migration phase.
